chapter_seo_title: Li Huowang Hunts Dice with a Ghost's Tip – Shangji Guankou Revealed
chapter_meta_description: A rare moment of hope: Zhuge Yuan reveals a mysterious entity called Shangji Guankou that can track Dice down. But it only exists in dead Great Qi, and Li Huowang must cross over alone.
og_title: The Hunt for Dice Begins: Shangji Guankou
og_description: Li Huowang learns of a cryptic being that can pinpoint the most wanted trickster in two empires—but it lies beyond the border of a fallen world.
twitter_title: Dice’s hunt just got a ghostly lead. Shangji Guankou.
twitter_description: Li Huowang crosses into dead Great Qi to find a being that can’t be described, only sought. The search for Dice intensifies.

lore_anchors.definition: A cryptic entity or location in Great Qi that can locate anyone; Zhuge Yuan describes it as a person, a demon, or a mountain gate depending on who you ask. Its name is deliberately ambiguous, refusing easy definition.
An underground energy channel in Chinese geomancy that sustains a dynasty's legitimacy; when a dragon vein breaks, it means the heavenly mandate has been revoked. Great Qi's vein was severed.

A core Daoist internal alchemy term for the pre-differentiated, fundamental energy of the universe. In this novel, losing control of it can forcibly drag Li Huowang back to the modern psychiatric ward.
The traditional Chinese title for the emperor, claiming he is a dragon incarnate with heavenly authority. In this world, it is literally true—the Dragon Vein shields the ruler inside the palace.

cultural_notes_faq.a: A cryptic entity or location only found in Great Qi; Zhuge Yuan says it can locate Dice, but refuses to define what it is—it looks different to different people and resists simple description.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why can't the Supervisory Heavenly Office just use Shangji Guankou?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because Shangji Guankou only exists in Great Qi. Great Liang does not have one. This means the knowledge died with the fallen empire, and only the dead (like Zhuge Yuan) know about it.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Did Zhuge Yuan know about the Dragon Vein's severance?
cultural_notes_faq.a: No. He died before the Dragon Vein was cut, and his knowledge ends there. His discomfort with the question reveals a rare crack in his composure.
He will have allies for the dealing-with-Dice part, but Zhuge Yuan makes it clear that Shangji Guankou can only *find* Dice—Li Huowang must handle the confrontation himself.
